summary: AssistantShell renders full screen as a modal and offers it when its modes list includes 'fullscreen'; useAssistantLayout().setMode('fullscreen') opens it, restoreMode() leaves it.
howTo: Add 'fullscreen' to AssistantShell/AssistantWorkspace modes; setMode('fullscreen') opens full screen, restoreMode() or Escape returns to defaultMode. A UI action that shows page UI calls restoreMode() first or puts that UI above --cm-chat-fullscreen-z (default 1000); page portals that must stay usable carry data-cm-keep-interactive.
